Pump Module.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Pump Module.reasoning: Used extensively for pump heads, pistons and fluid contact parts due to corrosion resistance and mechanical strength; standard in HPLC pump modules.

Pump Module.name: Titanium
Pump Module.reasoning: Occasionally used in pump components for chemical resistance; less common than stainless steel but utilized in high-purity or aggressive solvent pumps.

Pump Module.name: PTFE
Pump Module.reasoning: Used for seals, gaskets, and tubing due to chemical inertness and compatibility with solvents; essential for fluid path integrity.

Pump Module.name: Ceramic
Pump Module.reasoning: Employed in pistons and valve components for wear resistance and hardness; common but some pumps use hardened steel alternatives.

Chromatographic Column.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Standard material for column tubing providing mechanical strength and chemical resistance; widely used industry standard.

Chromatographic Column.name: C18 silica
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Primary stationary phase material bonded phase for reversed-phase chromatography; critical for chromatographic separation functionality.

Chromatographic Column.name: PTFE coating
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Applied on surfaces for chemical resistance and reduced adsorption; common coating though not always present depending on column design.

Chromatographic Column.name: Glass
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Sometimes used in column windows or frits; less common than steel but important for visual inspection or specialty columns.

Autosampler Module.name: Aluminum
Autosampler Module.reasoning: Structural frame and housing material due to lightweight and machinability; widely used for durable yet lightweight parts.

Autosampler Module.name: PTFE
Autosampler Module.reasoning: Used for fluid handling components such as tubing and seals for chemical inertness and solvent compatibility; essential for sample integrity.

Autosampler Module.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Autosampler Module.reasoning: Used in needle components and mechanical parts exposed to fluid; corrosion resistant and standard choice.

Autosampler Module.name: Ceramic
Autosampler Module.reasoning: Sometimes used for needle tips or wear-resistant components; alternatives like steel exist but ceramic improves durability.

Column Oven.name: Aluminum
Column Oven.reasoning: Common material for the oven body and heat sinks due to good thermal conductivity and lightweight properties.

Column Oven.name: Ceramic
Column Oven.reasoning: Used for insulation components and heating elements; provides high temperature resistance and electrical insulation.

Column Oven.name: PTFE
Column Oven.reasoning: Used in seals or tubing within heated zones due to chemical inertness and temperature tolerance; alternatives exist.

Instrument Enclosure And Frame.name: Aluminum
Instrument Enclosure And Frame.reasoning: Primary structural material for instrument casing and frame for durability, light weight and corrosion resistance; widely standard.

Instrument Enclosure And Frame.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Instrument Enclosure And Frame.reasoning: Used in frame reinforcements or fasteners within enclosure; corrosion resistant but not always primary material.

Valve Assembly.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Valve Assembly.reasoning: Primary material for valve bodies and internals for chemical resistance and mechanical strength; standard in chromatography valves.

Valve Assembly.name: PTFE
Valve Assembly.reasoning: Used for valve seals and seats due to chemical inertness and low friction; critical for fluid control integrity.

Valve Assembly.name: Ceramic
Valve Assembly.reasoning: Used in valve seats and seals for wear resistance and durability; common though alternatives like hardened steel exist.

Solvent Degassing Unit.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Solvent Degassing Unit.reasoning: Used for fluid path components and degassing chamber for corrosion resistance and mechanical strength.

Solvent Degassing Unit.name: PTFE
Solvent Degassing Unit.reasoning: Used for tubing and seals to ensure chemical inertness with solvents.

Solvent Degassing Unit.name: Glass
Solvent Degassing Unit.reasoning: Sometimes used in degassing chamber windows or sight glasses for visual monitoring; optional and replaceable.
